source.title: Anticoagulation for the initial treatment of venous thromboembolism in people with cancer
source.source_type: Cochrane intervention review / systematic review of randomized controlled trials
source.publication: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 2021, Issue 12

scaffold.semantic_scope: Review-level evidence architecture: study flow, included-study composition, cancer-subgroup data provenance, intervention/comparison families, follow-up structure, selected load-bearing trial characteristics, global risk-of-bias findings, missing subgroup information, and meaningful exclusion patterns.
source_pages_inspected: Physical PDF pp. 13-17 (article pp. 11-15): Figure 1, included-study narrative, Figures 2-3, global risk-of-bias results
Physical PDF pp. 29-50 (article pp. 27-48): Characteristics of included studies and characteristics of excluded studies
intentionally_deferred: Comparison-specific mortality, recurrent-VTE, bleeding, heterogeneity, and GRADE effect estimates
Summary of Findings tables and forest-plot quantitative result extraction
Full cell-by-cell atomization of each included-study characteristics and risk-of-bias table

duplicate_review.cross_batch_note: The prior cd006649-general-v1 validation explicitly deferred detailed included-study characteristics, study-flow results, and risk-of-bias results, reducing expected cross-batch overlap. A full semantic duplicate check should be repeated after all batches are merged.

source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.issue: Breddin 2001 cancer-subgroup count differs across inspected source locations.
locations: Results narrative: article p. 12 / PDF p. 14 reports 83 people with cancer
Characteristics table: article p. 28 / PDF p. 30 reports 137 (12%) people with cancer
source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.handling: The trial-characteristic atom preserves the characteristics-table value (137) and is tagged breddin_count_review_needed. No reconciliation was invented; the difference may reflect arm inclusion but is not explicitly resolved in the inspected text.

source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.issue: Excluded-study accounting is internally difficult to reconcile.
locations: Results narrative: article p. 13 / PDF p. 15 says 131 full-text articles were excluded, identifies 11 with unavailable cancer-subgroup outcomes, then says the remaining 123 articles were excluded for other reasons
Figure 1: article p. 11 / PDF p. 13 lists exclusion-reason counts 86 + 17 + 27 + 1 = 131
source_inconsistencies_requiring_human_r.handling: Both source reports were preserved separately. No corrected denominator was inferred.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom MVP is designed for primary literature, while CD006649 is a systematic review that summarizes trial-level evidence.

There is no dedicated atom kind for systematic-review study flow, included-study characteristics, risk-of-bias judgments, or secondary-reported trial descriptors; OTHER, METHOD, POPULATION_DESCRIPTION, and LIMITATION were used conservatively with systematic_review and secondary_reported_trial tags.
Trial-level characteristics are secondary reports anchored to the Cochrane review, not primary-study re-extractions. No primary-study provenance is implied.
Risk-of-bias judgments have no structured domain object in schema version 1.0 and are therefore preserved in canonical statements and descriptive tags.
extraction_limitations: Pass 0 was used only as routing and context; atoms were created from the original CD006649 PDF pages specified for this batch.
The batch intentionally uses one consolidated load-bearing characteristics atom per included study rather than atomizing every cell in the multi-page characteristics tables.
Comparison-specific effect estimates were not extracted because they are assigned to dedicated LMWH-UFH, fondaparinux-heparin, and dalteparin-tinzaparin batches.
No missing cancer type, subgroup outcome, follow-up, or trial-design details were invented.
All atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; structural/schema/sufficiency validation does not constitute human source-fidelity verification.
